The case takes a new twist when Logan and Wheeler delve deeper into the woman's wealthy family.

programs.desc: After Hodgins and Angela are drugged and wake up to a bloody corpse hanging in the canopy of their bed and flower petals around their son Michael's crib, they are forced to believe that Pelant is back for revenge against Hodgins.
